How to read this

Fits = no part of it goes through a wall. Tight = fits, but closer than 1 mm to a wall. Collides = goes through a wall or another part. Orange see-through boxes are room for jumper wires (a warning, not a hard limit). The check uses each part's outer box, so it is a little pessimistic near round walls. Parts that sit against their mount by design (matrix on its rails, speaker on its posts) are allowed to touch it.
